{{Top|leg}}
The '''Black Hole Team''' was a team of research scientists that worked for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] research and development branch, although their primary facilities were located on the moon [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. The Black Hole Team was established and funded to perform advanced research and development in the areas of alternative [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] development, mass mind control, and droid [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nanotechnology]]. During the final decades of the Old Republic, the Black Hole Team was also given the task of investigating [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-assisted [[Navigation computer/Legends|astrogation computers]].
